description: A STRING statement with its DELIMITED phrase omitted before INTO (ISO §2023:14.9.43.3 SR9: 'The DELIMITED phrase may be omitted only immediately preceding the INTO phrase. If it is omitted, DELIMITED BY SIZE is implied'). THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): ANSI X3.23-1985's STRING (§1985:VI.6.25.2) closes every sending group with an unbracketed `DELIMITED BY {identifier-2 | literal-2 | SIZE}`, and §1985:VI.6.25.4 GR2 knows no default: 'Literal-2 or the content of the data item referenced by identifier-2 indicates the character(s) delimiting the move. If the SIZE phrase is used, the content of the complete data item defined by identifier-1 or literal-1 is moved.' (every one of the 34 STRING statements in the NIST CCVS-85 suite writes it); §2002:14.8.39.2 SR8 adds 'The DELIMITED phrase may be omitted only immediately preceding the INTO phrase. If it is omitted, DELIMITED BY SIZE is implied', and §2002:F.2 states the change, its item 132: 'STRING statement. The DELIMITED phrase is optional in the STRING statement. DELIMITED BY SIZE is assumed.' §2014:14.9.39.2 SR9 carries the same sentence, so 2014 = 2023. Gated in ONE place, VersionConformancePass.VisitStringStatement, on the last sending phrase (kb/Work PB1567).
display: a STRING statement with the DELIMITED phrase omitted
vcr: STRING DELIMITED phrase optional (2002; quoted: §2002:14.8.39.2 SR8 and §2002:F.2 item 132 against §1985:VI.6.25.4 GR2); VCR row 7.31
